item.title: BREAKING: 1 person dead following overnight shooting in Butler
item.description: Mid America Live has confirmed that around 11:30 pm last night one person succumbed to injuries following a shooting on Dove Lane in south Butler.A 53 year old female was pronounced dead at the scene. While it appears the shooting was accidental, the investigation is ongoing and updates will be posted as information becomes available.
